articles.description: Kevin Ginkel, who had a 4.12 ERA in 74 games for the Diamondbacks last season, is joining the Twins on a two-year, $18 million contract.
articles.title: Twins bolster bullpen, signing Kevin Ginkel to a two-year contract

articles.description: The former No. 1 overall pick struggled through injuries and inconsistency in Minnesota, but at 27, he still has the potential to make the Twins regret moving on.
articles.title: Neal: Twins better have a plan to replace Royce Lewis’ bat after trading him

articles.description: The Twins remain active on the free-agent market, targeting a reliever and a hitter who could start on the right side of their infield. Here are names to know.
articles.title: Twins turn to bullpen and infield needs after fast start to MLB offseason

articles.description: Varland, a St. Paul native, won the inaugural American League Relief Pitcher of the Year award recently after his first full season with the Toronto Blue Jays.
articles.title: RandBall: Twins have one more reason to regret the Louis Varland trade

articles.description: Ryan Fitzgerald, a utility infielder, spent the entire 2026 season in Class AAA with the Los Angeles Dodgers. He hit .315 with 16 homers and 102 RBI in the minors.
articles.title: Backup infielder Ryan Fitzgerald returning to Twins on a one-year contract

articles.description: The 37-year-old pitcher said he wouldn’t have returned to Minnesota if he didn’t believe the Twins could win. The team plans to keep adding to its roster before a potential MLB lockout.
articles.title: Sonny Gray had options in free agency but chose Twins because he sees a winner

articles.description: The veteran righthander won an American League-leading 18 games with Boston this season and finished fifth in Cy Young voting. He rejoins Minnesota three years after leaving in free agency.
articles.title: Sonny Gray returns to Twins at age 37 on two-year, $55 million deal

articles.description: Ober had a 4.47 ERA last season, but he was squeezed out of the team’s plans for next year. The Twins also have decisions to make on Royce Lewis and Trevor Larnach.
articles.title: Twins cut Bailey Ober, Trevor Larnach in flurry of moves before MLB roster deadline

articles.description: A familiar face on Twins broadcasts since 2015, Martin said she had hoped to continue covering the team, but the decision to move on was not hers.
articles.title: Twins TV parts ways with longtime sideline reporter Audra Martin after 11 seasons

articles.description: Jeffers’ surprising return on a $23.15 million deal gives the Twins a chance to contend in 2027, but ownership must invest in the roster around him rather than squander another opportunity to win.
articles.title: Neal: Ryan Jeffers gave the Twins a gift — and now the Pohlads need to capitalize

articles.description: Lewis, the No. 1 overall pick in the 2017 MLB draft, hit .227 last season. The Twins got pitcher Bobby Miller and a minor-league catcher from Los Angeles in return.
articles.title: Twins trade Royce Lewis to Dodgers in what is expected to remain active offseason

articles.description: The 29-year-old catcher passed on pursuing a long-term deal in free agency and will become the Twins’ highest-paid player next season.
articles.title: Ryan Jeffers accepts $23.15 million qualifying offer, will return to Twins in 2027
